items.excerpt: Adobe and OpenAI have shipped a single unified plugin that exposes more than 70 Creative Cloud and productivity tools inside ChatGPT. Filmmakers can now describe an outcome and let the chatbot orchestrate which Adobe app actually does the work.
items.title: Adobe Announces It Is Further Integrating Into ChatGPT With New Unified Plugin

items.excerpt: Adobe folded its separate ChatGPT apps into one plugin covering over 70 Creative Cloud tools, from Photoshop and Premiere to Express and Acrobat. The plugin picks the right tool for a described task instead of asking the user to choose.
items.title: Adobe folds Photoshop, Express, Acrobat, and more into single ChatGPT plugin

items.excerpt: Eli Roth first described the animated sequences in his horror feature 'Ice Cream Man' as a traditional hand-drawn process, then confirmed generative AI was used in "a very small portion of a few scenes." The reversal reopens the question of how directors disclose AI in credited animation work.
items.title: Eli Roth Confirms 'Ice Cream Man' GenAI Use After First Describing A Traditional Animation Process

items.excerpt: Pixar co-founder and former Disney Animation president Ed Catmull has joined the jury of the Higgsfield Global Film Festival, a competition devoted entirely to generative-AI filmmaking. Higgsfield framed the move around Pixar's history of pairing artists with engineers.
items.title: Pixar Co-Founder Ed Catmull Joins Jury For GenAI Film Competition

items.excerpt: Brevidy is an AI toolkit that lives inside Adobe Premiere Pro, handling captioning, automatic clip extraction from long-form edits, vertical reframing and stock browsing in one panel. It targets the export-upload-reimport loop editors currently run for short-form deliverables.
items.title: Brevidy for Adobe Premiere Pro – AI Captions, Automatic Social Clips, and Vertical Reframing in One Panel

items.excerpt: Damian Allen walks through a "hybrid film set" built on Beeble's SwitchX and SwitchLight, where real actors and real camera moves are kept while backgrounds and lighting are regenerated in post. His framing for artists: "the AI result is a pass, not a result."
items.title: Is this the future of filmmaking?

items.excerpt: AniShort pulls scripting, storyboarding, character management, video generation, editing and rendering into one browser-based pipeline. The pitch is that most generative workflows don't solve production problems, they "simply move them further downstream."
items.title: AniShort Unifies Scriptwriting, Storyboarding & Video Generation in One Workflow

items.excerpt: Disney and TikTok will let creators build short-form videos from hundreds of official Disney assets, with selected results surfacing on Disney+'s vertical feed. Cartoon Brew contrasts it with the abandoned Disney–Sora deal: this one is asset remixing, not text-to-video generation.
items.title: Disney And TikTok Strike Deal To Bring Fan-Made Short-Form Videos To Disney+

items.excerpt: Motion Painter, a Blender add-on from NodeMonkey, lets animators draw motion paths straight in the viewport instead of keyframing on the timeline. Painted strokes convert into editable keyframes with multiple motion modes and custom brushes.
items.title: This Blender Add-On Lets You Draw Animation Paths in Viewport

items.excerpt: VFX supervisor Stephan Fleet looks back on eight years and 40 episodes of 'The Boys,' and how the final season pushed its effects work to its most extreme and grotesque. A craft counterpoint to the generative-tooling news cycle.
items.title: Bringing Closure with The Boys Season 5

items.excerpt: FilmLight named the first jurors for its 2026 Colour Awards, including cinematographers Jeff Cronenweth, Natalie Kingston and Chung-hoon Chung alongside colorist Tony D'Amore. Winners are announced at Camerimage in November.
items.title: FilmLight Announces First Jury Group for 2026 Colour Awards

items.excerpt: A production still from Warner Bros.' 'The End of Oak Street' showing Ewan McGregor on location with writer-director David Robert Mitchell. Practical, on-set craft imagery from a live shoot.
items.title: On The Set Pic: 'The End of Oak Street'

items.excerpt: Behind-the-scenes still of Tom Holland with director Destin Daniel Cretton on 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day,' shot by Jay Maidment. A look at how the practical side of a tentpole is still staged.
items.title: On The Set Pic: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'

items.excerpt: A breakdown of how 'Ted Lasso' season four executes a soft reboot: grounding change through setting, pivoting the premise without breaking established arcs, and keeping structure tight against ensemble bloat.
items.title: 3 Smart Screenwriting Lessons from the 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 Soft Reboot
